title: Research: conditional κ = 0.001673627634134309 via five interacting helpers
body:
## Summary

```diff
 exact PR3359 map, fixed selected local word and complete invoice
- kappa = 0.001673626873024029
+ kappa = 0.001673627634134309
+ neutral pair, then a three-helper cycle across five distinct helpers
```

An interacting neutral swap unlocks a strict paid-profile gain of `-2 H1 + H2`. The exact κ increase is `19027757/25000000000000000 = 7.61110280e-10`. The shared bin loses original widths 8,8 and gains 7,9, so this is outside an exactly-one-original-helper-out/in direct-cycle contract. The selected frontier is unchanged.

The isolated `research/t16-neutral-unlock/` package contains the proof, literal generator, exact 217-row reconstruction of PR3359, source pins, full admission/invoice receipts and failure controls. No solver or unmerged Git object is required. This answers PR3359's explicit neutral-rearrangement question while preserving its six cycles and PR3354's original cycle.

## Evidence

- Before: two idle rank-one remainders. After: one rank-two remainder, with the exact improvement `2^(1-a) < 2` for every real `0<a<1`. Five helpers relocate and 18 rows change including offsets. Both intermediate and final complete maps pass the independent 69,120-role audit; mass 1,041,408 and deficit 5,120 remain.
- Full unchanged eleven-stage strict admission passes, including controls 69/12/6/15, eleven independent owner controls, both supplier bills, both seven-step bootstraps and all 47 strict outer inequalities per path. Entire typed invoice equality retains every charge and unknown key, excluding only three source bindings. Prefix 397 stays paid at 512, row coefficient 16,469; actual charts decrease from 10,008 to 10,005 without a paid-cost reduction.
- Eleven behavioral groups pass normally and optimized. The triple alone overfills a bin; partial, reversed, wrong-family/width, overlapping-role, non-neutral and corrupt-source controls reject. Invoice controls reject changes to value, type, keys and array order. Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, Ruff, metadata/pins and exact 60-file publication-byte/source-history checks pass. A fresh Git-free committed export replays the same full admission.
- Reproduce: `TMPDIR="$RUN" python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-neutral-unlock`, with `$RUN` an existing external output directory. The fixed-word cap is `1690054109089/1001690054109089`; this witness realizes about 99.1954%. Canonical submission refresh remains `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, revision 6; PR3359's exact live head remains `3bdc260e996fd3a94dcb7560b68f2c61d2253d80`.

Concurrent [PR3369](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3369) proves a direct-cycle obstruction on PR3359 and includes its independent fixed boundary control for this exact candidate. The shared bin has two original departures, so the results have distinct scopes.

This is a conditional finite packing witness. All inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer and bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. No optimum, full multiplication theorem, fresh cold native rebuild, independent human review or hosted-CI success is claimed. Open next questions are scoped in the package.

Credit Pierre / hexapode for PR3359 and its question; Nick Petalas for PR3354/3338; Gonzalo Mier, Philippe Van Velzen, Jeremy Kothe, Rohan Arun, Hao Yan, George Lydakis, Josie Elliston and the retained compiler/native/bit/moment lineage. Assistance disclosure and original notices are retained in the package.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. One isolated research package; no shared checker, frozen input or selected record changes.

Blast radius: package.
